dominance.evidence_budget_note: B4 and B6 read two edges the frozen core already computes every tick and then discards; no new sensor, no new channel and no additional arithmetic

H1.statement: a fast-detector-plus-CSIA architecture has lower detection latency than current CSIA at matched observed false-alarm operating points

H2.false_escalation_note: the hybrid's only added action is a generic caution on a provisional fast alarm; nominal runs carry no fault so any caution there is a false escalation and is counted in the nominal arm
H2.note: measured on the imu_isolation arm, the only arm on which an attributing response exists at all
H2.statement: the hybrid does not increase unsupported confident attribution, incorrect actionable decisions, action conflicts or false escalation

H3.primary_measure: support availability for the decision pair under EG (amendment 19)
H3.statement: an experimental correction for FL-029 reduces false refusals without increasing unsupported confident outputs or action conflicts

H4.statement: a fast and slow evidence accumulator improves abrupt-fault latency without materially worsening gradual-fault detection

H5.statement: the hybrid retains or improves the observed threshold robustness seen in Phase 4

what_this_is_not: not a production-core result -- B4 and B6 rest on a SHADOW support map the frozen core does not use; not hardware, not flight, not SITL, not autopilot execution; not pooled with any earlier phase; and not a claim that CSIA outperforms CUSUM, which Phase 4 measured the other way on latency
